judgment_methodology.method: DAMA-DMBOK data quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) as the acceptance lens for a pipeline change

planning_methodology.method: Kimball dimensional-modeling lifecycle (business requirements -> dimensional design -> ETL design -> deployment)
planning_methodology.source: Kimball & Ross, The Data Warehouse Toolkit, 3rd ed (Wiley 2013); kimballgroup.com/data-warehouse-business-intelligence-resources/kimball-techniques/dw-bi-lifecycle-method

deliverable_form.method: Pipeline design doc naming source system, grain, SLA, and idempotency guarantee
deliverable_form.source: Reis & Housley, Fundamentals of Data Engineering (O'Reilly 2022)

feedback_methodology.method: Code review checklist scoped to pipeline correctness (schema drift, backfill safety, exactly-once semantics)

review_methodology.method: Data-quality dimension audit against DAMA-DMBOK's six dimensions before sign-off

degree_level_knowledge.source: Kimball & Ross, The Data Warehouse Toolkit, 3rd ed (Wiley 2013)
Reis & Housley, Fundamentals of Data Engineering (O'Reilly 2022)

reference_resolution.rule: model_name must resolve to an actual dbt model file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-running dbt's contract check against model_name's current schema.yml, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: dbt contract enforcement (`config: {contract: {enforced: true}}`) present on every changed model, checked by dbt parse/compile against schema.yml
quality_bar.verified_source: dbt Developer Hub, contract config reference — https://docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-configs/contract (primary vendor spec; `contract: {enforced: true}` requires every column name+data_type, dbt runs a preflight check and fails the build on mismatch).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the pipeline change state a concrete rollback path (revert migration, backfill script, or feature-flagged read path) distinct from 'redeploy previous version'?
quality_bar.verified_source: No single named canonical source in the spec (source_standard covers dbt contracts, not rollback policy); this is general SRE/release-engineering practice (concrete rollback path over 'redeploy'), not a formally published normative rule. Kept as practitioner-consensus, human-review-checklist only.

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: for each of DAMA-DMBOK's dimensions accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness (a 4-of-8 subset of DMBOK2's full dimension set — DMBOK2 also names validity, integrity, uniqueness, and reasonability, out of scope for this criterion), does the change state how that dimension is affected and, if degraded, why that is acceptable?
quality_bar.verified_source: DAMA-DMBOK 2nd ed. lists EIGHT dimensions in its current (DMBOK2) revision — accuracy, validity, completeness, integrity, uniqueness, timeliness, reasonability, consistency (https://www.damadmbok.org/dmbok2-revisions) — not the four cited in the criterion. The four chosen (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) are a real subset of DAMA's canonical set, not an invented list, but the criterion undersells the full DMBOK2 bar. Criterion text corrected below to state explicitly that it is a 4-of-8 subset, so a reviewer does not read it as the complete DAMA bar.

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that a schema-drift or freshness test (dbt source freshness / schema test) exists for every changed source or model
quality_bar.verified_source: dbt Developer Hub, freshness reference — https://docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-properties/freshness (primary vendor spec; source freshness configured via warn_after/error_after against loaded_at_field is dbt's own documented drift-detection mechanism).

use_when.board_condition: a dbt model's schema.yml changed on the branch AND no data-engineering record exists yet for that commit sha
